subject: MUC-MIA incl. export clearance
body:
Hi,

kindly quote MUC to MIA, 4 crates of machine parts, 540 kg, 2.2 cbm, ready 26.11., we deliver to Munich airport. Cheapest option, EUR.

Please include export customs clearance (EAD/ATLAS filing) in the all-in price; we have no customs broker of our own.

Best regards
Stefan Berger
Shipping
Allgäu Maschinen GmbH
